title: Restore install and directory-target publish do not surface a staging file left after a no-replace move
outcome: Restore install and directory-target publish do not surface a staging file left after a no-replace move
acceptance: Where restore's install moves its staging file into place and the move reports that the staging file remained (directory::Moved.leftover), restore names that file to the operator: in its receipt on success and in its refusal when a later step fails. A test pins the named leftover.
Where the directory target's publish moves its temporary file into place and the move reports that the file remained, push names it in its warnings. A test pins the named leftover.
